image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a chiton (polyplacophore) clinging to a dark, rocky substrate. The organism displays its characteristic eight overlapping dorsal calcareous plates (valves) surrounded by a textured, leathery girdle. The plates are brownish with intricate growth line patterns, and the girdle is cream-colored with darker mottling.
